simple.prompt: Our enterprise ___ a regional branch in Kuala Lumpur three years ago.
simple.explanation: 'Three years ago' adalah penanda waktu lampau yang sudah selesai dan spesifik (finished time), sehingga wajib memakai Past Simple: 'opened'.
hints: Perhatikan keterangan waktu 'three years ago'.
Waktu lampau spesifik mewajibkan bentuk Past Simple (V2).

simple.prompt: We ___ significant growth in organic website traffic so far this quarter.
simple.explanation: 'So far this quarter' merujuk pada kurun waktu yang belum selesai (unfinished time) dan berlanjut ke masa kini, sehingga memakai Present Perfect: 'have observed'.
hints: Kuartal ini masih berjalan hingga sekarang (so far this quarter).
Gunakan Present Perfect untuk kurun waktu yang belum tuntas.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple dengan penanda waktu lampau spesifik.
simple.targetSentence: She graduated from university last year.
simple.explanation: Subject (She) + V2 (graduated) + from university + finished past time (last year).
hints: Mulai dengan subject 'She'.
Penanda waktu 'last year' diletakkan di akhir.

simple.prompt: I ___ to four European capital cities in my lifetime.
simple.explanation: Pengalaman hidup seumur hidup (life experience tanpa menyebutkan waktu lampau spesifik) menggunakan Present Perfect: 'have traveled'.
hints: Menceritakan pengalaman hidup tanpa tanggal lampau tertentu.
Gunakan Present Perfect.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman hidup Present Perfect.
simple.targetSentence: They have never visited our headquarters.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + have never + V3 (visited) + our headquarters.
hints: Mulai dengan 'They have never'.
V3 adalah 'visited'.

simple.prompt: At what time ___ your flight land this morning?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan yang menanyakan titik jam tertentu di masa lampau ('At what time...') selalu menggunakan Past Simple dengan auxiliary 'did'.
hints: Menanyakan jam kedatangan spesifik yang sudah lewat.
Gunakan auxiliary Past Simple 'did'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya pengalaman dengan 'Have you ever'.
simple.targetSentence: Have you ever led a major project?
simple.explanation: Have you ever + V3 (led) + Object (a major project)?
hints: Awali dengan 'Have you ever'.
V3 dari lead adalah led.

simple.prompt: I ___ my umbrella on the commuter train yesterday morning.
simple.explanation: 'Yesterday morning' adalah waktu lampau yang sudah selesai sepenuhnya, jadi gunakan Past Simple ('left').
hints: Lihat keterangan waktu 'yesterday morning'.
Waktu lampau selesai memakai Past Simple.

simple.prompt: Look! Someone ___ fresh flowers on the reception desk.
simple.explanation: Bukti nyata saat ini ('Look!') tanpa menyebutkan kapan waktu terjadinya di masa lalu memakai Present Perfect ('has placed').
hints: Pembicara menunjukkan hasil yang terlihat sekarang.
Tanpa penanda waktu lampau tertentu, pakai Present Perfect.

simple.prompt: Our accounting firm ___ three new branch offices in 2022.
simple.explanation: Tahun tertentu yang sudah lewat ('in 2022') selalu berpasangan dengan Past Simple ('opened').
hints: Tahun 2022 sudah selesai berlalu.
Gunakan Past Simple.

simple.prompt: ___ you ever tried Indonesian single-origin pour-over coffee?
simple.explanation: Menanyakan pengalaman hidup sampai saat ini dengan kata 'ever' menggunakan Present Perfect ('Have you ever...?').
hints: Kata kunci pengalaman hidup adalah 'ever'.
Gunakan auxiliary Present Perfect 'Have'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang konfirmasi pengiriman dokumen.
dialogue: Client
Have you received our signed nondisclosure form?
Coordinator
Yes, it ___ in our legal inbox twenty minutes ago.
simple.explanation: Penanda waktu lampau spesifik ('twenty minutes ago') mengunci kalimat ke Past Simple ('arrived').
hints: Perhatikan akhir kalimat: 'twenty minutes ago'.
Frasa '...ago' selalu memakai Past Simple.

simple.prompt: Ms. Clara ___ our logistics supervisor for six years and still leads the team today.
simple.explanation: Keadaan yang mulai 6 tahun lalu dan masih berlangsung sampai sekarang ('still leads the team today') memakai Present Perfect ('has been').
hints: Masih menjabat hingga hari ini.
Keadaan berlanjut memakai Present Perfect.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan waktu lampau spesifik dan Present Perfect berikut.
simple.draft: Our marketing team has attended the Singapore trade fair last November.
options: Our marketing team attended the Singapore trade fair last November.
Our marketing team attend the Singapore trade fair last November.
Our marketing team had attended the Singapore trade fair last November always.
simple.explanation: 'Last November' adalah waktu lampau tertutup; tidak boleh memakai Present Perfect ('has attended'), ubah ke Past Simple ('attended').
hints: Ada kata waktu spesifik lampau 'last November'.
Ganti 'has attended' menjadi V2 'attended'.

simple.prompt: My parents ___ in Yogyakarta before they moved to Semarang in 2010.
simple.explanation: Periode tinggal di Yogyakarta sudah berakhir sebelum pindah pada 2010, jadi memakai Past Simple ('lived').
hints: Kejadian tinggal di Yogyakarta sudah selesai.
Masa lalu yang tuntas memakai Past Simple.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman umum tanpa keterangan waktu spesifik.
simple.targetSentence: We have visited the maritime museum several times.
simple.explanation: 'Several times' tanpa batas waktu lampau tertutup menunjukkan pengalaman hingga kini (Present Perfect).
hints: Awali dengan 'We have visited'.
Akhiri dengan 'several times'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Simple untuk peristiwa berpenanda waktu jelas.
simple.targetSentence: Did you speak with the customs officer last Tuesday?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan tentang waktu spesifik ('last Tuesday') memakai Past Simple: Did + S + V1.
hints: Mulai pertanyaan dengan 'Did you speak'.
Akhiri dengan 'last Tuesday?'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog pergantian tense dari umum ke spesifik.
dialogue: Manager
Have you ever negotiated an enterprise software license?
Candidate
Yes, I have. In fact, I ___ a major multi-year deal two months ago.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika percakapan beralih dari pengalaman umum (Present Perfect) ke peristiwa spesifik berwaktu lampau ('two months ago'), tense beralih ke Past Simple: 'I closed'.
hints: Ada penanda waktu spesifik 'two months ago'.
Beralih ke bentuk Past Simple V2.

intermediate.prompt: Shakespeare ___ thirty-seven plays during his lifetime.
intermediate.explanation: Karena Shakespeare sudah meninggal dunia (hidupnya adalah periode waktu yang sudah selesai sepenuhnya), wajib menggunakan Past Simple: 'wrote', bukan Present Perfect.
hints: Tokoh sejarah yang sudah tiada (periode hidup sudah tutup).
Gunakan Past Simple 'wrote'.

intermediate.prompt: Haruki Murakami ___ numerous internationally acclaimed novels.
intermediate.explanation: Karena penulis masih hidup dan masih berpotensi menulis karya baru, pencapaian hidupnya menggunakan Present Perfect: 'has written'.
hints: Penulis masih hidup dan periode karirnya masih berlangsung.
Gunakan Present Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang membedakan dampak masa kini (present result).
intermediate.targetSentence: I have lost my security pass and cannot enter the building.
intermediate.explanation: Present result: kehilangan kartu terjadi sebelumnya tetapi dampaknya langsung terasa saat ini (cannot enter), sehingga memakai Present Perfect: 'have lost'.
hints: Aksi lampau dengan dampak langsung saat ini.
Gunakan 'I have lost my security pass'.

intermediate.prompt: The package ___ thirty minutes ago, but nobody ___ it yet.
intermediate.explanation: 'Thirty minutes ago' menandakan Past Simple ('arrived'), sedangkan 'yet' menandakan Present Perfect negatif ('has opened').
hints: Bagian pertama ada 'ago' (Past Simple).
Bagian kedua ada 'yet' (Present Perfect).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat berita baru (hot news) dengan Present Perfect.
intermediate.targetSentence: The government has announced a new tax policy.
intermediate.explanation: Berita baru yang baru saja diumumkan tanpa keterangan waktu spesifik: 'has announced'.
hints: Pemberitaan kabar baru (news announcement).
Gunakan 'The government has announced'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih respon yang membedakan waktu selesai dan waktu berjalan.
dialogue: Colleague
Did you drink coffee this morning?
Engineer (speaking at 3:00 p.m.)
Yes, I ___ two cups before noon.
intermediate.explanation: Karena percakapan dilakukan sore hari (pukul 3 sore), waktu 'this morning' dan 'before noon' sudah menjadi periode waktu yang selesai, sehingga memakai Past Simple: 'drank'.
hints: Pukul 3 sore berarti 'this morning' sudah selesai sepenuhnya.
Gunakan Past Simple 'drank'.

intermediate.prompt: Compare carefully: 'When ___ the engineering lead join our studio?' (asking about a past hiring date)
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan berawalan 'When...?' menanyakan titik waktu spesifik di masa lampau, sehingga hampir selalu memakai Past Simple ('When did... join?'), bukan Present Perfect.
hints: Kata tanya 'When' meminta waktu kejadian spesifik di masa lalu.
Gunakan auxiliary Past Simple 'did'.

intermediate.prompt: So far this week, our support team ___ forty-two onboarding tickets.
intermediate.explanation: Karena 'this week' belum selesai dan ada penanda 'So far', gunakan Present Perfect ('has resolved').
hints: Periode 'this week' masih berjalan saat berbicara.
Pilih Present Perfect 'has resolved'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang operasi tentang perbedaan berita baru vs detail waktu.
dialogue: Lead
Guess what — Elena ___ the regional design competition!
Colleague
Really? When did the judges announce the winners?
intermediate.explanation: Kalimat pertama mengumumkan berita hangat baru tanpa menyebut waktu (Present Perfect 'has won'); lalu pertanyaan berikutnya menanyakan detail waktunya memakai Past Simple ('When did...').
hints: Mengumumkan kabar terbaru tanpa rincian jam/hari memakai Present Perfect.
Detail susulan baru memakai Past Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Did you notice whether the courier ___ the receipt before leaving?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam narasi masa lalu ('Did you notice... before leaving'), tindakan penandatanganan terjadi selesai di masa lampau, memakai Past Simple ('signed').
hints: Konteks kalimat sepenuhnya di masa lampau.
Gunakan V2 'signed'.

intermediate.prompt: Over the last five years, coastal erosion ___ several wooden piers in this district.
intermediate.explanation: 'Over the last five years' berarti rentang lima tahun hingga detik ini (masih relevan), sehingga memakai Present Perfect ('has damaged').
hints: 'Over the last...' menghubungkan masa lalu langsung ke masa sekarang.
Subjek tunggal 'coastal erosion' memakai 'has damaged'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan pemilihan tense pada pertanyaan 'When' berikut.
intermediate.draft: When have you finished translating the technical appendix?
options: When did you finish translating the technical appendix?
When had you finished translating the technical appendix yesterday?
When are you finish translating the technical appendix?
intermediate.explanation: Jangan menggunakan Present Perfect bersama kata tanya waktu lampau 'When'; ganti menjadi Past Simple ('When did you finish...?').
hints: 'When...?' tidak kompatibel dengan Present Perfect untuk menanyakan titik waktu lalu.
Pakai 'When did you finish...?'

intermediate.prompt: I ___ my keys three times already this morning, and it isn't even noon!
intermediate.explanation: Karena 'this morning' masih berlangsung ('it isn't even noon!'), gunakan Present Perfect ('have misplaced').
hints: Pagi hari ini belum selesai saat kalimat diucapkan.
Periode waktu terbuka memakai Present Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: By contrast, at 4 p.m. she said: 'I ___ my keys twice this morning, before lunch.'
intermediate.explanation: Pada jam 4 sore, 'this morning' dan 'before lunch' sudah berakhir sempurna, sehingga bergeser menjadi Past Simple ('misplaced').
hints: Saat jam 4 sore, waktu pagi sudah selesai lewat.
Periode tertutup memakai Past Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka berita hangat diikuti detail waktu lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: They have launched the update, and users reported smooth logins yesterday.
intermediate.explanation: Berita hasil kini memakai 'have launched', sementara kejadian spesifik 'yesterday' memakai Past Simple 'reported'.
hints: Awali dengan 'They have launched the update,'.
Tambahkan detail lampau 'and users reported smooth logins yesterday'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman berperiode terbuka sampai sekarang.
intermediate.targetSentence: Nothing like this has ever happened since the clinic opened.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa utama hasil hingga kini memakai Present Perfect ('has ever happened'), diikuti 'since' + Past Simple ('opened').
hints: Mulai dengan 'Nothing like this has ever happened'.
Akhiri dengan 'since the clinic opened'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan penggunaan Present Perfect dengan kata tanya waktu 'When'.
complex.draft: When have you submitted the revised architectural blueprint?
options: When did you submit the revised architectural blueprint?
When have you been submitting the revised architectural blueprint?
When you submitted the revised architectural blueprint?
complex.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan 'When' selalu menanyakan titik waktu spesifik di masa lalu, sehingga pantang menggunakan Present Perfect (*When have you...). Wajib menggunakan Past Simple: 'When did you submit...?'.
hints: Pertanyaan 'When' tidak pernah memakai Present Perfect.
Ubah menjadi Past Simple 'When did you submit'.

complex.prompt: In journalism headline vs details: 'A catastrophic earthquake ___ a coastal province. The tremor ___ at 04:12 local time.'
complex.explanation: Dalam jurnalistik bahasa Inggris, judul atau pembuka kabar menggunakan Present Perfect ('has struck'), lalu rincian waktu spesifik berikutnya beralih ke Past Simple ('struck at 04:12').
hints: Kabar pembuka memakai Present Perfect.
Detail waktu spesifik beralih ke Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Notice the difference with 'for': 'He ___ in Singapore for ten years, and he still lives there now. His father ___ in Singapore for ten years, but then moved to Tokyo.'
complex.explanation: Jika keadaan masih berlangsung hingga kini ('still lives there now'), gunakan Present Perfect: 'has lived'. Jika periode 10 tahun tersebut sudah tuntas dan sudah pindah ('moved to Tokyo'), gunakan Past Simple: 'lived'.
hints: Masih tinggal di sana sekarang $\rightarrow$ Present Perfect.
Sudah pindah dan masa tinggal sudah usai $\rightarrow$ Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat yang membedakan klausa 'since' (Past Simple) dan klausa utama (Present Perfect).
complex.targetSentence: We haven't seen each other since we left high school.
complex.explanation: Main clause (We haven't seen each other - Present Perfect) + since + clause titik awal (since we left high school - Past Simple).
hints: Klausa utama: 'We haven't seen each other'.
Klausa setelah since memakai Past Simple: 'since we left high school'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan Past Simple pada periode waktu yang belum selesai.
complex.draft: I didn't receive any customer inquiries this morning (the current time is 10:00 a.m.).
options: I haven't received any customer inquiries this morning.
I wasn't receiving any customer inquiries this morning.
I had not received any customer inquiries this morning.
complex.explanation: Karena waktu saat ini masih pukul 10:00 pagi (periode 'this morning' belum selesai), kalimat harus menggunakan Present Perfect: 'I haven't received...'.
hints: Waktu saat berbicara masih pagi (belum siang).
Periode waktu belum selesai memakai Present Perfect.

complex.prompt: It is exactly twelve months since the diplomatic mission ___ established.
complex.explanation: Setelah pola 'It is + durasi + since...', klausa titik awal menggunakan Past Simple: 'since the diplomatic mission was established'.
hints: Pola: It is (time) since (Past Simple).
Gunakan Past Simple pasif 'was established'.

dialogue: Auditor
Did you find out who authorized the illegal transfer?
Investigator
Yes, our audit ___ that the chief accountant signed the release on October 4th.
complex.explanation: Penyelidikan berfokus pada hasil temuan dari berkas bertanggal spesifik ('on October 4th'), sehingga menggunakan Past Simple: 'revealed'.
hints: Fokus pada fakta historis yang sudah selesai diverifikasi.
Gunakan Past Simple 'revealed'.

complex.prompt: In business correspondence, compare: 'Our company has operated sustainably for twenty years' vs 'Our predecessor firm ___ sustainably for twenty years before merging in 1998.'
complex.explanation: Perusahaan pendahulu itu sudah tidak berdiri terpisah sejak merger tahun 1998; durasi 'for twenty years' yang telah tutup sepenuhnya di masa lalu memakai Past Simple ('operated').
hints: 'For twenty years' tidak otomatis Present Perfect jika rentangnya sudah tamat pada 1998.
Gunakan Past Simple 'operated'.

complex.prompt: Throughout his fifty-year career, the late architect ___ over eighty civic libraries across Asia.
complex.explanation: Kata 'the late architect' menandakan arsitek tersebut telah wafat sehingga rentang karyanya sudah tertutup tuntas di masa lalu: gunakan Past Simple ('designed').
hints: Tokoh ('the late architect') sudah meninggal dunia.
Karya tokoh yang sudah tiada memakai Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan logika aspek dalam kalimat laporan arkeologi berikut.
complex.draft: Ancient Roman engineers have built aqueducts that still stand across Spain today.
options: Ancient Roman engineers built aqueducts that still stand across Spain today.
Ancient Roman engineers had built aqueducts that still stand across Spain today.
Ancient Roman engineers have been building aqueducts that still stand across Spain today.
complex.explanation: Peradaban Romawi Kuno dan para insinyurnya hidup di masa lalu yang sudah tutup sempurna, meskipun bangunannya masih berdiri; gunakan Past Simple ('built').
hints: Bangunan boleh masih berdiri, tetapi pelaku ('Ancient Roman engineers') hidup di era lampau yang selesai.
Pakai Past Simple 'built'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang rujukan riset yang masih relevan.
dialogue: Supervisor
Why did you use Present Perfect in 'Recent studies have demonstrated a clear link...'?
Researcher
Because those findings ___ and remain directly relevant to our current hypothesis.
options: form an ongoing conversation up to today
were completely disproven before the study
complex.explanation: Dalam penulisan literatur ilmiah (Literature Review), 'Studies have demonstrated...' memakai Present Perfect untuk merujuk temuan terkini yang masih membentuk diskusi riset hingga kini.
hints: Present Perfect dalam tinjauan pustaka menghubungkan riset terdahulu dengan riset saat ini.
Pilih alasan akademis yang tepat.

complex.prompt: This is only the second time that independent auditors ___ such an exception in the past decade.
complex.explanation: Pola 'This is the first/second time that...' selalu mengharuskan Present Perfect ('have granted') pada klausa pengikutnya.
hints: Lihat pola 'This is only the second time that...'.
Subjek jamak 'independent auditors' memakai 'have granted'.

complex.prompt: Hardly had the ink dried when the supplier ___ to honor the revised schedule.
complex.explanation: Kalimat inversi Past Perfect ('Hardly had + S + V3 when...') berpasangan secara baku dengan klausa kedua ber-Past Simple ('refused').
hints: Klausa pertama memakai Past Perfect ('had... dried').
Kejadian penyusul segera setelahnya memakai Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan pencampuran 'ever' dengan titik lampau tertutup pada kalimat biografi berikut.
complex.draft: Did the novelist ever revised her debut manuscript after she passed away in 1974?
options: Did the novelist ever revise her debut manuscript before she passed away in 1974?
Has the novelist ever revised her debut manuscript before she passed away in 1974?
Was the novelist ever revised her debut manuscript before she passed away in 1974?
complex.explanation: 'Ever' boleh dipakai dalam Past Simple ('Did the novelist ever revise...') untuk kehidupan tokoh yang sudah tutup, asalkan setelah 'Did' memakai V1 'revise' dan logika 'before she passed away' benar.
hints: Setelah 'Did', verb wajib V1 ('revise').
Pastikan keterangan urutan waktunya logis ('before she passed away').

complex.prompt: Up until yesterday's announcement, shareholders ___ no indication of a leadership transition.
complex.explanation: 'Up until yesterday's announcement' adalah titik batas di masa lalu ('yesterday'), bukan hari ini! Sebelum satu titik lampau menggunakan Past Perfect ('had received'), bukan Present Perfect.
hints: Titik acuan akhirnya adalah 'yesterday', bukan saat ini.
Sebelum titik lampau memakai 'had received'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal kontras Present Perfect dan Past Simple dalam satu laporan.
complex.targetSentence: Our lab has tested twelve polymers this year, whereas last year it tested only five.
complex.explanation: 'This year' (masih berjalan) memakai Present Perfect 'has tested'; 'last year' (sudah tutup) memakai Past Simple 'tested'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Our lab has tested twelve polymers this year,'.
Tambahkan klausa kontras 'whereas last year it tested only five'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat berpola 'It has been [duration] since + Past Simple'.
complex.targetSentence: It has been nearly eighteen months since the coastal bridge reopened.
complex.explanation: Durasi hingga kini memakai 'It has been...', diikuti 'since' + Past Simple ('reopened').
hints: Mulai dengan 'It has been nearly eighteen months'.
Akhiri dengan 'since the coastal bridge reopened'.
